description:
About Us_
// At Masabi, we’re driving the fare payment revolution, powering the journeys of millions all over the world. We build fare collection platforms that allow riders to seamlessly buy and present tickets for public transport either on their mobile phones, from a ticket machine, or even by tapping their bank card to travel. 

Our Justride platform is used in over 250 locations globally, including some of the largest cities in the world. With our industry-first mobile ticketing SDK, we’ve partnered with large players in the transport space, including Uber, Moovit and Transit. 

Your own journey is important to us too. Choosing a role here means joining a network of innovators from all walks of life; a group of passionate individuals who consistently deliver. Here, you’ll find the tools you need to build the career you want. Whether you’re taking the direct route or trying a new path, we’ll support you no matter what. 

The Role_

// We're looking for a Senior AI Engineer to help build the AI capabilities that will live inside Justride, the platform behind fare collection for transit agencies around the world. This is a 12-month contractor role, with potential for extension.

Justride holds the fares, rules and ticketing data that keep public transport moving. You'll help turn that into AI features that riders and agency teams can trust, especially where getting the answer right really matters.

This is a hands-on role across the full stack. You'll build the services and the interfaces agency teams use, including new experiences in Justride Hub, our back-office platform for agencies. You'll take features from idea to production, help shape how we test, release and run AI safely, and share what you learn so engineers across Masabi can build with AI with confidence.

You'll join a small, growing AI team at an exciting moment, with plenty of room to shape how things are done. We work on early proofs of concept as well as production features, often without detailed tickets, so you'll shape the work as much as deliver it.

Location_

// This is a fully remote contract role for candidates based in Romania

Responsibilities_

  • Design and build AI agents and features end to end, from model integration and backend services through to the interfaces people use

  • Build the frontend for our AI features, so agency teams get experiences that feel clear and easy to trust

  • Connect Justride with the AI tools riders and agency teams already use, in a safe and reliable way

  • Set up testing, evaluation and monitoring, so we understand how AI features behave before and after release

  • Make thoughtful choices on models, prompting, retrieval and tool use, balancing quality, speed and cost

  • Make sure AI features use our platform's rules and data accurately wherever precision matters

  • Partner with product and design colleagues to turn early ideas and proofs of concept into production products

  • Help shape good practice for building with AI across engineering, through reviews, guidance and pairing

  • Contribute to security and privacy reviews for features that handle rider and payment data

About You_

  • A track record of taking AI agents or LLM-based features into production, where real users rely on them

  • Someone who takes initiative and is at ease with ambiguity, able to take a loosely defined problem from proof of concept to production

  • A strong full-stack background, including frontend (TypeScript and a modern framework such as Vue) and backend (ideally Python), ready to own the Justride Hub UI and use AI coding tools with good judgement

  • Hands-on experience with retrieval, tool use or agent frameworks, and a good sense of where they fall short

  • Practical experience evaluating and monitoring AI systems, and using what you learn to improve them

  • Confidence working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and modern engineering practices

  • Generous with your knowledge and keen to help the engineers around you grow

  • A clear communicator when explaining technical ideas to people with different backgrounds

If you've done work like this but don't match every line, we'd still love to hear from you

Nice To Have_

  • Experience building integrations for AI assistants or agent platforms, such as MCP

  • Experience working with payments or other regulated data

  • Experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform)

  • Kotlin or Java backend experience

  • Experience with distributed systems and microservices

  • Experience in transit, ticketing or B2B SaaS

Careers at Masabi are for people going places - driven by a mission to make transit fair and accessible for all.

// We are a network of innovators from all walks of life, passionate about making a difference. At Masabi, we operate with openness and trust, creating an environment where everyone feels empowered to bring their whole, authentic selves to work.

Whoever you are, just be yourself.
// We welcome applications from underrepresented groups, including disabled and neurodivergent people, and can make adjustments at any stage of the process. You’re also welcome to share your pronouns whenever you feel comfortable. Together, we simplify journeys, remove barriers, and improve daily life for millions.

Why Join Masabi?

  • Driven by Purpose – We believe in journeys made simple. The work isn’t always easy, but the best things never are.

  • Encouraged to Accelerate – Masabi is going places and our people are in the driving seat. Whether you’re taking the direct route or exploring new paths, we support your journey.

  • Advancing with Empathy – We put people first and foster a culture of learning, not blame. No matter your cargo, we share the load.

We’re already powering journeys - are you ready to join us?
